g.text: over the k nearest in-vocab words
the vocabulary here is the EMBEDDING's, not the
Degenerate inputs: SubwordEmbedding falls back to
−ln |V_e| on an empty context; SimilarWords falls
back to −ln |V_e| when no neighbour has positive
similarity, but yields exactly −1.0 on an empty
context (every cosine against the zero vector is 0).
Surface (a) needs no OOV *detection*: the MKN
recursion bottoms out at a strictly positive
unigram, so an unseen word simply lands on 1/|V|.
